modules.identity_rule: Each ACRL micro-module must have a unique machine-readable module_id.
modules.lineage_rule: New modules must declare derived_from and supersedes relationships when applicable.
modules.dependency_rule: New modules must declare direct module dependencies.
modules.capability_rule: Capabilities belong to capability_registry.py and are referenced by ID rather than duplicated here.
modules.authority_rule: Authority relationships belong to dependency_authority_map.py and must not be duplicated here.
modules.execution_rule: ACRL modules do not independently advance gates or mutate controller state.
modules.immutability_rule: Frozen modules are not modified merely to add unrelated capabilities; new capabilities should prefer new micro-modules.
